rules: Each line amount must equal quantity (hours) times unit_rate.
The sum of all line amounts must equal the invoice total.
Every labor line's hourly rate must equal the contract rate card rate for that employee's role.
No employee may be billed on more than one labor line for the same week ending date.
Every non-labor charge must be on the contract's allowed charges list and must not exceed its cap.
Billed hours for an employee and week must not exceed the approved_hours on that employee's timecard for the same week ending date.
If any check fails, recommend dispute and ask the vendor for a credit memo; if all checks pass, approve.
open_questions: Is overtime above 40 hours a week billable at 1.5 times the rate?
